preconditions.description: The length of the input text must not exceed 10000 characters.
The input text must start and end with a Latin letter.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz ,.!? ' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input text must only contain lowercase Latin letters, spaces, and specified punctuation marks.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ' '.join(word for word in stdin.split() if word.isalpha()) + ' ' + ' '.join(punct for punct in stdin.split() if punct in ',.!?')
postconditions.description: The output must have words separated by exactly one space and punctuation marks followed by exactly one space.
The output must not end with a space.
